info.title: CiteBrand API
info.summary: Whether AI engines name and link a brand, with evidence for every number.
info.description: Agent docs: https://api.citebrand.ai/docs. MCP: https://api.citebrand.ai/mcp. Every response carries meta { schema, schema_version, generated_at, request_id, cost_usd, sources, sample_sizes }; every rate carries n, source and evidence ids.

post.description:
Register a brand's site. The homepage is fetched live (the audit) and must answer; the response includes the audit. Idempotent per domain: registering again updates brand and aliases. v1.1: for non-operator keys the site starts unverified and site.verification carries the token to publish (DNS TXT or /.well-known/citebrand-verify.txt) before POST /v1/sites/{domain}/verify.

Cost: free (plain HTTP audit, ~2-5 s).

post.description:
v1.1. Looks for citebrand-verify=<token> (the token from POST /v1/sites) in a DNS TXT record of the domain, then in https://<domain>/.well-known/citebrand-verify.txt. Unverified sites can be audited and measured (public data) but cannot receive plans, deliverables or the outreach list. Tokens last 7 days; POST /v1/sites again for a new one. Operator sites are always verified.

Cost: free (one DNS lookup and one HTTP fetch).

post.description:
Ask AI engines buyer questions and record whether they name and link the brand. Returns 202 with a job; poll status_url or register a webhook. External keys: DataForSEO engines only (google, chatgpt-ui, gemini-ui, perplexity, bing). Questions: questions[] you send, or questions_from_run, or (default) the site's previous questions, or its discovered questions.

Cost: DataForSEO per answer: google ~$0.004 (up to $0.008), chatgpt-ui and gemini-ui $0.004, perplexity ~$0.02 (up to $0.05), bing $0.002; 1-15 minutes; free with dry_run.

parameters.description: v1.1: 1 = return the job this request would create (engines, cost estimate, budget), status 200, without creating it or spending anything. Also accepted as "dry_run": true in the body.

questions.description: 1-20 buyer questions, without the brand name.

questions_from_run.description: Reuse the questions of this run id (and compare with the previous run).

questions_count.description: Owner keys only: write this many new questions from the homepage (one claude call).

engines.description: Default for external keys: google, chatgpt-ui, gemini-ui, perplexity.

samples.description: Answers per question and engine (default 1; 3 is steadier).

brand_lists.description: Owner keys only: list competitor brands in DataForSEO answers (one claude call).

max_cost_usd.description: Refuse to start when the estimate could exceed this (USD). Also the DataForSEO budget the engine enforces call by call (lowered to the key's own cap when it has one).

agent-readiness.title: Agent readiness (v1.2): can an AI agent get structured answers from the site? Five forward-looking checks and a 0-100 sub-score

status.description: pass = present, info = absent. Never fail.

agent-visit.title: Agent visit (v1.2): what our agent could obtain on the site and how many buyer questions it answered from stated facts

local.description: A local test page (the kit installed on a copy), not the live site.

audit.title: Live site audit: crawlability for AI bots, title, description, canonical, h1, indexability, server-rendered text, freshness signal, llms.txt, sitemap, platform

group.description: v1.2: agent_readiness checks carry group; they are not counted in score.

agent_readiness.description: v1.2: forward-looking checks (pass = present, info = absent, never fail) with their own 0-100 sub-score: webmcp_tools 30, public_facts 25, mcp_endpoint 20, openapi 15, agent_card 10.

category.title: Category AI share of voice (DataForSEO LLM Mentions): you vs competitors per platform, monthly history, new and lost, top cited domains and pages

common.meta.description: On every response. cost_usd is the vendor cost of this call (0 for reads of stored runs; a job's cost is on the job).

common.source.description: Where a number came from: the engine(s), their lane, the vendor and how it was called.

common.lane.description: cli: assistants with web search; ui: the consumer ChatGPT and Gemini apps; serp: AI answers on the results page. Never blended.

common.metric.description: A rate with its sample size, source and the ids of the answers that hit (resolvable at /v1/evidence/{id}).

crawl-check.title: Crawl check (v1.1): can AI crawlers read the site, per page and per AI user agent, plus Lighthouse

caveat.description: User-agent rules only; IP or verified-bot rules are not tested.

bot_wall.description: Every agent got a challenge at least once: a wall for the fetcher's servers, not a user-agent rule.

baseline.description: A plain fetch with a browser user agent (free).

challenged.description: Lighthouse landed on a challenge or another page: the scores are not the page's.

deliverable.title: A publishable deliverable for one plan item: the page, the technical artifacts, or the outreach list, as markdown

evidence.title: One piece of evidence: a raw answer, a fetched page, or a screenshot

screenshot.description: v1.1: a stored proof screenshot of a search results page. url returns the PNG (?format=png); data_url is included with ?format=data_url.

task_source.description: live: the id of the live call that produced the answer; standard: a standard-queue task posted for the screenshot.

ref.description: The id the analyst and plan use for this answer (A1, A2, …) within its run.

screenshot.description: v1.1: the shot_… id of a proof screenshot of this answer's results page, when one was captured.

facts-verify.title: Facts verification (1.3): is the live /.well-known/citebrand-facts.json signed by the key the domain publishes (DNS TXT _citebrand.<domain>, then /.well-known/citebrand-key.txt)?

reason.description: signature valid; ... | not signed | key not published | facts changed after signing | signature invalid | signature expired | domain mismatch | no facts file: ...

expires_at.description: Recomputed as signed_at + 90 days (the document's own expires_at is not trusted).

facts.title: Verified facts (v1.2): facts about a brand quoted from its own pages, each with its source page and the exact quote, merged with the owner's edits

id.description: Stable content hash (f_…), or o_… for a fact the owner added.

title.description: Product or plan name, contact type, place, competitor, or the FAQ question.

text.description: The fact in one sentence in the site's own terms; for a FAQ, the answer.

price.description: Plans only: the price exactly as printed; null when the site prints none.

source_url.description: The page the quote is on; null only for owner_asserted facts.

quote.description: The exact text on source_url (checked in code); null when the owner restated it.

owner_asserted.description: The owner stated this without a page.

site_quote.description: For an edited fact, the site's original quote.

health.title: Health (1.3): is the service up, and what can it do right now. No key needed; no secrets.

status.description: ok: database answers and the DataForSEO engines are configured; degraded: database ok but no engine for external keys; down: the database does not answer.

external_keys.description: Engines an external key can measure with now.

operator_only.description: CLI engines available to operator keys on this machine.

history.title: Every finished run's per-lane rates and per-engine counts, oldest first, and the latest comparison

job.title: Jobs: accepted (202 from measure, plan, category, discover, outreach, crawl-check, mentions, proof), one job, a list, a cancellation, or a dry run (v1.1: ?dry_run=1 returns the job it would create, 200, nothing started)

cancelled.description: v1.1 DELETE /v1/jobs/{id}: true when this call cancelled the job.

killed.description: What the cancel did to each process (wrapper and current step).

would_create.description: v1.1 dry run: the job this request would start, with its engines and cost estimate. No job row is written and nothing is spent.

budget_usd.description: The DataForSEO cap the engine would enforce: max_cost_usd lowered to the key's cap.

conflict.description: A job of this kind already running for the site (a real start would be 409 job_already_running).

me.title: The calling key, its customer, scopes and what it may run

mentions.title: Mentions (v1.1): what news, blog and forum pages say about the brand (DataForSEO Content Analysis)

relevance.description: domain/alias: clearly the brand; name_only: the bare word, may mean something else; none: the snippet does not show it.

linked.description: Whether the page links to the brand's domain (null: not checked or could not be fetched).

outreach.title: Outreach list (v1.1): who to ask for a link or a mention, ranked, with why, what to ask for and the evidence

n.description: Domains linking to 2+ competitors but not to you.

rival.description: The domain is a brand the answers named as a competitor.

plan.title: The ranked, evidence-cited plan for a run (analyst + critic), merged with its plain-language layer

standing.description: v1.2: standing items added by code, not by the analyst. agent_ready (id AR1) is present while the audit's agent readiness is below 100; its deliverable is the site kit (GET /v1/sites/{domain}/sitekit).

proof.title: Proof screenshots (v1.1): dated images of the Google results pages behind a run's Google answers

url.description: GET it for the PNG (same auth).

public-facts.title: Public facts (v1.2; signed since 1.3): the citebrand-facts/1 document a site hosts at /.well-known/citebrand-facts.json, served by CiteBrand without a key for verified sites

extracted_at.description: 1.3: when the pages were read; part of the signed facts.

signature.description: 1.3: base64 Ed25519 signature over canonical JSON of { domain, facts: { extracted_at, about, products, plans, contact, locations, comparisons, faqs }, signed_at }.

key_id.description: cbk_ + first 16 hex of SHA-256 of the raw public key.

expires_at.description: signed_at + 90 days; verifiers recompute it from signed_at.

facts_hash.description: SHA-256 hex of the canonical JSON of the signed facts.

key_dns.description: The DNS name whose TXT record carries citebrand-key=v1;ed25519;<base64>.

source_url.description: The page of the site the quote is on (empty only for owner_asserted items).

questions.title: Buyer questions discovered from search demand, with the keywords and monthly volumes behind each, and who really competes

runs.title: Every measurement run of a site, newest first, with which artifacts each has

search-data.title: Search data (DataForSEO) for a run: demand per question, Google's top 10, rankings, gaps, and how much AI citations overlap Google

sitekit.title: Site kit (v1.2): the WebMCP script, the .well-known facts files and how to install them

tools.description: The read-only WebMCP tools the script registers.

skipped.description: Tools left out because the site states nothing for them.

sites.title: Sites: a list (GET /v1/sites), one site (GET /v1/sites/{domain}) or a new one with its audit (POST /v1/sites)

check.description: v1.1 POST /v1/sites/{domain}/verify: what the DNS and file checks saw.

verified.description: v1.1: ownership verified (always true for the operator). Unverified sites can be audited and measured but get no plans or deliverables.

verification.description: v1.1: how to verify, while unverified: publish txt_record as a DNS TXT record of the domain, or put it in file_url, then POST verify_url.

subscription.title: A weekly re-measure subscription (or its removal)

usage.title: Usage for a window: calls per endpoint with vendor cost and price, and every job with its DataForSEO cost

visibility.title: Visibility: one measurement, per lane and engine, with the comparison against the previous run

evidence.description: v1.1: every successful answer of this lane, with whether it named (mentioned) and linked (cited) the brand. Never empty when the lane has answers; the metrics' evidence lists only the hits.

cited_domains.description: v1.1: every domain the answers cited, counted once per answer, attributed per lane and per engine (the splits sum to answers), with the ids of the answers that cited it.

webhooks.title: Webhooks: created (secret shown once), listed, deleted, or a delivery log
